Date: 15th January 2026

TO: O'Malley Brothers Manufacturing Ltd

FROM: Lennon & Associates Solicitors, Dublin

Dear Mr O'Malley,

We write to confirm our appointment to advise O'Malley Brothers Manufacturing Ltd (registered as Company 12547890 at the Companies Registration Office) in relation to the proposed acquisition of the premises at Unit 7, Ballygall Industrial Estate, Dublin 11 (the "Property"). This property comprises approximately 2,450 square metres of industrial warehouse space with adjoining office accommodation of 380 square metres.

Our firm, Lennon & Associates Solicitors, has been established for thirty-two years and specialises in commercial property transactions for manufacturing and distribution businesses. We have extensive experience in advising on industrial property acquisitions in the Dublin area and have completed over 280 similar transactions in the past five years alone. Our team includes specialists in property law, planning matters, and environmental compliance for industrial premises.

Our fees for this matter shall be calculated as follows:
- Fixed fee for title examination and searches: €2,850
- Hourly rate for post-exchange work: €195 per hour
- Estimated total cost to completion: €4,200
- Disbursements (Land Registry fees, searches from local authorities, environmental reports): estimated €380
- Total estimated professional fees and disbursements: €4,580

Note on fee revisions: Earlier draft of engagement letter (dated 10th January 2026) contained estimated cost of €3,800 based on preliminary assessment. This was revised to €4,200 upon more detailed review of the work scope.

Payment terms: We require 50% of the fixed fee (€1,425) upon signature of this letter, with a further 25% (€712.50) at the point of exchange of contracts, and the balance of all costs due within 7 days of completion. Should costs exceed our estimate by more than 10%, we will notify you in writing and seek your written approval before proceeding.

The timeframe for this transaction is expected to be 12 weeks from the date of this letter, with anticipated completion on or around 15th April 2026. However, this timeline is dependent on satisfactory results from all searches and surveys, and we will keep you updated on progress at each stage.

Our work will include the following:
1. Detailed examination of the property's title deeds and Land Registry folios to verify clear ownership and identify any legal encumbrances
2. Ordering and reviewing local authority searches, environmental reports, and planning history
3. Liaising with the seller's solicitors regarding enquiries raised during our investigation
4. Advising on any defects in title or adverse matters revealed by our investigations
5. Preparation and negotiation of contract terms
6. Acting for you at exchange of contracts and through to completion
7. Post-completion formalities including registration at the Land Registry and notification of local authorities

Liability cap: Our liability to you shall be limited to €10,000 for any single claim arising from our advice on this matter, except that this cap does not apply to claims arising from professional indemnity insurance coverage or to claims arising from our breach of fundamental contractual obligations regarding the management of your funds. This limitation of liability is a standard provision in our engagement terms and reflects market practice in our profession.

In the event of dispute regarding costs, either party may refer the matter to the Law Society of Ireland for determination under their costs complaint procedures. The Law Society maintains an independent costs assessment service to which either party may appeal if they believe fees charged are unreasonable.

We have obtained professional indemnity insurance cover from Legal Protect Insurance plc, policy number LP-2026-0847, with cover of €500,000 per claim and in aggregate €2,000,000 per annum. Our insurance covers all aspects of property transactions and provides protection to our clients in the event of a claim arising from professional negligence.

The retainer is on an exclusive basis for acquisition work relating to Unit 7, Ballygall Industrial Estate only. Any supplementary advice on landlord and tenant law, planning matters, environmental compliance, or employment contracts shall be billed separately at our standard hourly rates of €195 per hour for senior associates and €145 per hour for junior staff. We will always seek your approval before undertaking work outside the scope of this engagement.

We remain your solicitors until completion of the transaction, after which our engagement automatically terminates unless agreed in writing. Following completion, we can provide you with ongoing advice on property management, lease documentation for any tenants, or other legal matters at our standard hourly rates.

Governing law: This engagement letter is governed by the laws of the Republic of Ireland and is subject to the Solicitors Acts 1954 to 2015 and the Law Society of Ireland's professional regulations.

Confidentiality: All information you provide to us will be treated in confidence and in accordance with our professional obligations and data protection legislation. We will not disclose any information about your transaction to third parties except as required by law or with your written consent.

Your solicitors,

Lennon & Associates Solicitors
Dublin Office, 4 Molesworth Street, Dublin 2

Telephone: +353 1 661 5200
Fax: +353 1 661 5201
Email: info@lennonassociates.ie

Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM

---

Date approved: 14th January 2026

We confirm that we have received your signed instructions on 15th January 2026 and have commenced work on your behalf. A copy of this letter will be retained on your file for record purposes. If you have any questions about any matter contained herein, please do not hesitate to contact us immediately.

Ms Brennan initially considered requesting removal of the fence within 20 days to allow Mr Murphy time to investigate the boundary.
